consent.title: Connect {{name}} to Madar?
consent.returnsTo: After you answer, Madar sends you back to {{host}}.
consent.unknownHost: Madar does not know {{host}}. Approve only if you started this connection yourself, in an AI app you trust.
consent.rights: acts with your rights, so it can see and change what you can
consent.history: shows its name and yours on each change, and you can undo its changes
consent.account: can also use your account outside the Madar screens, for example to change your password
consent.remove: keeps this access until you remove it in Settings, Agents
consent.missing: This link is not complete. Start the connection again in your AI app.
consent.leaving: Madar is sending you back to your AI app.

agents.title: Agents
agents.intro: AI apps that act for you in Madar.
